description: Fetches one job of the caller's audio queue by id (GET /queue/{id}): status (queued, active, done, failed, cancelled), stage (analyze, align), per-step status, progress and rank. An unknown id and a job of another account answer the same 404. Needs the queue:read scope. Costs no quota.

id.description: Job id returned by jj_audio_analyze or jj_queue_list.

name: jj_queue_get_job
title: Get an audio analysis job
